subject: Ridgeview SIG traceability matrix & collector instructions
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@ridgeviewfinancial.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@ridgeviewfinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-09T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: RFI: SIG questionnaire — traceability matrix and initial evidence requests

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Ridgeview is consolidating the security materials for our platform review and we received the SIG questionnaire from our procurement team. Two asks to start:

1) Can you provide a SIG traceability matrix that maps your responses to the SIG controls (v3) and references the artifact filenames?
2) We also need a short list of the collectors/owners and a recommended ingest schedule for evidence (logs, access lists, key rotation records) — Ridgeview's audit window is Nov 22–30, so we need material staged early.

Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? Also let us know if any items require an NDA or additional access (SFTP/drive share).

Appreciate it — Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Senior Security Program Manager
Ridgeview Financial
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@ridgeviewfinancial.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-09T10:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: RFI: SIG questionnaire — traceability matrix and initial evidence requests

Alicia — thanks for the note. We can absolutely support this. High-level plan:

- Marissa (security lead) will produce the SIG traceability matrix and annotate artifact filenames.
- We'll stage an evidence bundle in a shared Drive folder and provide a short collector/ingest checklist for your audit team.
- If any items require an NDA or restricted access, we will flag them immediately; otherwise we'll share via a locked Drive link.

ETA: preliminary matrix and checklist by EOD Monday (2026-11-10), full artifact bundle uploaded by Thursday (2026-11-12).

Next steps: Marissa, can you confirm owners and whether we need any privileged access from Ridgeview? Karthik, loop in infra if we need log extracts.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@ridgeviewfinancial.com>, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-10T14:22:00-05:00
Subject: SIG traceability matrix + collector instructions (draft)

Alicia / Sean — attaching the first pass: redwood_sig_traceability_v1.xlsx (tabbed by control family). Highlights / notes below: 

- Scope: Hosted Redwood API + Dedicated runtime. Controls mapped to SIG v3.0 names in column B; evidence pointers in column F.
- Artifacts we will upload: access-logs-sample-2026-10.zip (sample logs for API/VPC access), kms-rotation-procedures.pdf (key rotation and HSM process), env-pen-test-summary-2026.pdf (summary of latest engagement).
- Collectors / owners:
  * Access logs: infra-logs-collector (owner: infra@redwood.com / contact: Karthik Iyer) — recommended ingest cadence: weekly extracts; for audit window provide full Oct–Nov slice.
  * Config snapshots: config-collector (owner: platform-ops@redwood.com) — provide snapshot from 2026-10-31 and one at start of audit.
  * Key rotation artifacts: security-ops (owner: marissa_cole@redwood.com) — provide rotation logs and RCA for any anomalies.

Access and delivery: we will stage the artifacts in a Drive folder and share a locked link. If you prefer SFTP or an encrypted bundle, tell us and we will arrange. A few of the artifacts include internal metadata (user IDs redacted) — we can provide sanitized extracts if required.

Known gaps: For a small subset of SIG controls that reference 3rd-party deployments (monitoring service), we provide attestations and SOC2 snapshot but not raw telemetry — let us know if you need an escalation to the vendor.

Attachments: redwood_sig_traceability_v1.xlsx (attached), sample artifact list referenced above.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@ridgeviewfinancial.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-11T11:05:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG traceability matrix + collector instructions (draft)

Marissa — this looks good, thank you. A few clarifying Qs from our audit team: 

1) For access log samples, can you provide a quick readme that explains field names and how you map IPs to regions? Our audit folks need the context.
2) For KMS rotation docs, do you have a signed runbook or only internal SOPs? We need evidence of execution (rotation event IDs).
3) For the controls where you reference a 3rd-party monitoring vendor, can you supply the SOC snapshot or contact we should reach out to?

If you can send the readme and rotation event IDs by EOD Wednesday (11/11), we can confirm the audit schedule. Also confirm whether Ridgeview needs an NDA before we access the Drive folder.

Best,
Alicia
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@ridgeviewfinancial.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-12T16:48:00-05:00
Subject: Re: SIG traceability matrix + collector instructions (draft)

Alicia — quick update and delivery plan: 

- Readme for access logs: attached as access-logs-readme.md (short explainer, field mapping, IP-to-region heuristics).
- KMS rotation evidence: rotation_event_ids.csv (contains event IDs and timestamps) plus kms-rotation-procedures.pdf. Rotation events show monthly rotation cadence; hashes are redacted for export.
- 3rd-party monitoring vendor: vendor SOC snapshot (vendor-soc-snapshot-2026Q2.pdf) included and contact is support@observa-monitor.com. We have authorization to share the SOC snapshot.

Drive link (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-ridgeview-evidence — we can open access once you confirm the email list. No NDA required for the materials we're sharing; if you need an executed NDA for extended access to raw telemetry we can kick that off.

Proposed artifact delivery schedule:
- Today (11/12): upload readme + rotation_event_ids.csv + vendor SOC snapshot + traceability matrix (final).
- Tomorrow (11/13): upload full access log slice (as encrypted zip).

If that timeline works, Sean and I will prepare a short handoff note and a list of contacts for your audit team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
